extractor_notes.blockers: Not a clinical-stage drug developer. Biomerica is a diagnostics company; its lead product inFoods IBS is a CLIA-certified Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) rather than an FDA-regulated drug or device with PDUFA/NDA/BLA timelines. Available 8-Ks cover board appointments and general business updates; no forward-looking drug-pipeline catalysts (clinical-trial topline dates, FDA submissions, approvals) are disclosed.
